description: Intent i015 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=tx-csum-invariant) complete. FINDING (high confidence): net/packet/af_packet.c tpacket_snd(), lines 2671-2723. When the packet socket has po->has_vnet_hdr, line 2672 'vnet_hdr = data;' points a struct virtio_net_hdr pointer directly into the user mmap'd TPACKET TX ring frame obtained from packet_current_frame(po, &po->tx_ring, TP_STATUS_SEND_REQUEST) — concurrently writable memory, with no READ_ONCE, no private copy, and no lock spanning the accesses. __packet_snd_vnet_parse(vnet_hdr, tp_len) at line 2676 validates csum_start+csum_offset+2 against hdr_len and hdr_len against tp_len (af_packet.c:2416-2430), and copylen at 2680-2681 plus tpacket_fill_skb() at 2695 size and populate the skb; then virtio_net_hdr_to_skb(skb, vnet_hdr, vio_le()) at line 2719 and virtio_net_hdr_set_proto at 2723 independently re-read hdr->csum_start/csum_offset/gso_type from the same shared ring memory, so a racing userspace writer can change the values between the validation fetch and the use fetch — the seed's validate-once/use-a-different-fetch TOCTOU pattern. Unsafe use: the re-read values reach skb_partial_csum_set() (include/linux/virtio_net.h:54-59), setting skb->csum_start/skb->csum_offset and CHECKSUM_PARTIAL on the TX skb, consumed as checksum indices by TX checksum-offload computation. Counterevidence/bound: skb_partial_csum_set (net/core/skbuff.c:4396-4411) independently re-validates the second fetch against skb_headlen in u32 arithmetic, so the csum pair alone cannot go OOB; the concrete divergence affects hdr_len/gso/flags consistency between 2676 and 2719-2723 (skb sizing at 2680-2687, protocol at 2723) — recorded as a validate-vs-use inconsistency hypothesis with bounded impact, expressed in the artifact's confidence/limitations. Safe negatives with evidence: drivers/net/tun.c:1759-1764/1855 (gso copied to stack via copy_from_iter_full), drivers/net/tap.c:647-659/709 (vnet_hdr copied to stack), net/packet/af_packet.c:2439/2916 packet_snd path (stack vnet_hdr), include/linux/virtio_net.h:54-59 + net/core/skbuff.c:4396-4411 (single fetch into locals, csum_start+off+2 <= skb_headlen validated in u32 on the exact used values). Unexamined/limited: drivers/net/virtio_net.c:1024 header provenance not fully traced, ibmveth.c:1297 and remaining per-driver offload sites not deeply audited; static analysis only, no reproducer run.
